# Robomotion Skills

The skill library for the Robomotion **Hermes Agent**. A skill is a folder with a `SKILL.md` that teaches the agent how to do one kind of task, sometimes with scripts it can run. Skills come in packs: all but one are taken from popular open-source Agent Skills repositories, and `designer-skills` is our own.

Pick the skills an agent needs in the Designer; the agent loads them when it runs.
